description: Expense Ledger (Node, Express): six routes work; a negative amount is accepted and the per-category summary is wrong.

claims.text: POST /expenses refuses an amount that is not a positive number with 400
POST /expenses records an expense with an amount and a category and refuses a missing category
GET /expenses lists expenses newest first and supports ?category= and ?limit=
DELETE /expenses/:id removes an expense and answers 404 for an unknown id
PATCH /expenses/:id changes the note or the category of an expense
GET /expenses/summary returns the total spent and the correct total for each category
GET /expenses/export returns all expenses as CSV with a header row
